title: hub_status.json — status file written by a monitor, read by the monitor hub (adapter "generic")

updated.description: ISO 8601 local time of this monitoring round, e.g. 2026-09-28T21:45:00

headline.description: One-sentence conclusion in Chinese, e.g. 所有作业正常运行，无需操作。

summary.description: Short counts; empty = the hub counts the tags (完成 n，运行 n，排队 n，异常 n)

done.description: true when every planned job is finished and the final results are written

tags.description: One per row: done / run / queue / bad / other (not managed by this monitor) / empty

attention.description: Only decisions the user must make, in plain Chinese

working.description: What the background Claude takeover is doing right now, if anything

notes.description: Quota, queue reasons and other remarks

next.description: ISO time of the next round (ignored for scheduled tasks: the scheduler knows)

results.description: Final deliverables, listed on the 最终结果 page

error.description: Failure of the monitor itself (e.g. ssh unreachable); not a compute failure
